component.name: Media Player Pro
component.summary: Modern media player with transparent glass controls, red theme, and video enhancement

description.p: Media Player Pro is an advanced, high-performance media player built on top of mpv. It features a non-obstructive 100% transparent bottom bar with floating red controls, playback memory remembering the last 20 unfinished videos with an interactive resume prompt, interactive cursor-targeted zoom and dragging, speed dropup selector, and a 3-level genuine video enhancement engine powered by AMD FidelityFX Contrast Adaptive Sharpening (CAS) and deband filtering.

ul.li: TrueTheater-style GPU Video Enhancement Engine: Contrast Adaptive Sharpening (CAS), Adaptive Local Tone Mapping lighting, and skin-tone protected chroma vibrance in a unified real-time GLSL master shader
Interactive Hover Tooltips: Frosted glass tooltips for all dock controls on hover
Aspect Ratio Submenu: Interactive selector with active ratio display (Auto, 16:9, 4:3, 21:9, 16:10, 1:1)
Settings Toggle: Single 1-click ON/OFF toggle for TrueTheater video enhancement, persistent across restarts
A/B Comparison Diagnostic Mode: 50% split-screen before/after shader view toggleable via Ctrl+Shift+E
Streamlined Dock: Cleaned up window controls from dock bar for distraction-free media experience
Smart Resume Memory: Remembers last 20 unfinished videos and prompts to resume or start over
Red-based theme with glowing red seekbar line and scrubber thumb
100% transparent bottom bar removing background occlusion so video is completely unobstructed
Clean media skip backward (◄◄) and forward (►►) icons (removing '7s' text)
New frosted glass surround app icon with vibrant red play button
Full dual Wayland and X11 compositor compatibility with fallback context probing

description.p: Media Player Pro v1.1 Initial Release
